authority: MV-IA-F020/F021 permissions, hidden information and recovery
principles: Authorize and filter before hidden settings, locations, routes, factions, history, secrets, counts, map labels, summaries, exports, diagnostics, notifications, pathfinding or AI context are serialized or aggregated.
Reusable World/Setting Definitions remain separate from Campaign/Scene instantiation and current setting state.

Typed hierarchy supports worlds, realms, branches, planes, planets, cities, stations, generation ships, routes, zones, districts and other source-supported setting entities without planet-only assumptions.

Hierarchy, membership, route, chronology and compatibility require explicit source evidence or governed authoring provenance; same document, name similarity, proximity, theme and co-occurrence are insufficient.
Environment templates are reusable evidence and do not instantiate named-setting facts until explicitly attached.
World-local content and mechanics remain scoped; PPIA-12 does not replace owning Creature, Item, Vehicle, Species, Ability or rules definitions and does not universalize local rules.
Random tables, templates, AI assistance and inferred cross-references create proposals only until explicit governed acceptance.
Unknown and conflicted source states remain explicit; revision-heavy material is never silently reconciled.
Every hierarchy, route, environment and reveal workflow has keyboard, touch and nonvisual textual alternatives; maps are supplemental rather than authoritative.

visibility_classes.definition_public: Published setting-definition fields permitted to the viewer.
visibility_classes.campaign_revealed: Campaign facts, locations, routes, factions and history explicitly revealed to the viewer.
visibility_classes.campaign_gm_private: GM-only hidden locations, routes, secrets, unrevealed history and current state.
visibility_classes.author_private: Draft authoring proposals and unpublished setting changes visible only to authorized authors.
visibility_classes.source_diagnostic: Source/conflict/revision/provenance diagnostics limited by provenance permission.
visibility_classes.service_minimum: Operation-specific minimum projection for services/AI; never independent setting authority.

field_groups.label: World / Setting Identity & Definition
field_groups.projection_rule: Inspecting a reusable Setting Definition does not create a Campaign instance or current Scene state.

field_groups.label: Cosmology, Branch, Reality & Plane Placement
field_groups.evidence_rule: Placement requires explicit source or governed authoring evidence; thematic similarity or co-occurrence is insufficient.

field_groups.label: Region, Location & Site Hierarchy
field_groups.evidence_rule: Parent/child and membership relations require typed explicit evidence; nonplanetary types remain first-class.

field_groups.label: Environment, Biome & Hazard Profile
field_groups.classification_rule: Reusable environment templates remain templates until explicitly attached to a setting scope.

field_groups.label: World-local Content Extensions
field_groups.handoff_rule: Core object Definitions remain owned by PPIA-02/03/04/05 or the relevant Ability/rules domain.

field_groups.label: World-local Rules & Mechanics
field_groups.scope_rule: Setting-local mechanics remain local until separately authorized for broader scope.

field_groups.label: Campaign Instance & Current Setting State
field_groups.mutation_rule: Campaign/Scene state is owned by PPIA-08 and references reusable PPIA-12 Definitions without rewriting them.

field_groups.label: Knowledge, Discovery, Secrets & Reveal
field_groups.privacy_rule: Filter before search, counts, maps, summaries, pathfinding, errors, exports, notifications and AI context.

field_groups.label: Provenance, Conflict, Authoring History & Recovery
field_groups.recovery_rule: Ambiguous writes require operation-status lookup before retry; conflicts/revisions remain explicit and raw source is immutable.

role_projection.player: May see published source facts and Campaign-revealed setting facts only; hidden locations, routes, secrets, unrevealed factions/history and GM-only current state are absent before aggregates and pathfinding.
role_projection.gm: Campaign-scoped authority may expose hidden/revealed Campaign setting truth where policy permits, but source governance and unrelated Campaign/private authoring remain separate.
role_projection.assistant_gm: Receives minimum delegated projection and cannot independently author hierarchy, reveal secrets, resolve conflicts, promote local mechanics or commit Campaign state.
role_projection.creator_owner_admin: May author/govern within explicit scope, but retained source facts, reusable Definitions, Campaign instances, reveal state and promotion decisions remain separate write paths.
role_projection.service_ai: Receives minimum role-safe fields with hidden facts removed and has no independent canonical-authoring, universalization, conflict-resolution or reveal authority.

responsive_accessibility.large: Expanded inspector may show textual hierarchy, optional map, facets, provenance and compare panes.
responsive_accessibility.medium: Inspector prioritizes semantic hierarchy and selected-context details; optional map remains secondary.
responsive_accessibility.compact: Single-column text-first hierarchy/route/environment flow with progressive disclosure.
responsive_accessibility.keyboard: All authoring, inspection, expansion, route review and reveal controls are operable without pointer-only interaction.
responsive_accessibility.screen_reader: Hierarchy levels, relation types, routes, reveal state, source/conflict status and validation results use labeled semantic text.
responsive_accessibility.high_zoom_reflow: No required workflow depends on fixed canvas geometry or two-dimensional map position.
responsive_accessibility.reduced_motion: Animation is decorative only and never conveys authoritative travel, hierarchy, reveal or state transitions.
responsive_accessibility.nonvisual_navigation: Every map/hierarchy/route fact has a textual relation list and navigable semantic outline.
